---
title: "Terrorism"
description: "Terrorism involves non-state actors using violence and propaganda for political or ideological goals, often with state actors manipulating these groups to destabilize adversaries while maintaining plausible deniability."
categories: ["Sabotage"]
---

::: {.function-badge}
[Sabotage](../function/sabotage.qmd)
:::

A non-state actor that employs violence, intimidation, and propaganda to achieve political, ideological, or religious objectives. Within sabotage functions, terrorist groups may be created, directed, or exploited by state actors to destabilize adversaries, generate chaos, or advance geopolitical interests under conditions of plausible deniability.
